application.title: Preliminary Plan and Pattern Book Update- The Enclave at Parkside

resolutions.summary: The Planning Commission voted unanimously to close the public hearing for the Enclave at Parkside preliminary plan. The developer responded to staff comments: end unit side yard setback will remain 5 feet (not the 10-foot staff preference); building separation distances will remain as proposed; Note 33 will follow code requirements. The developer requested conditional approval, but Chair Singleton stated the Commission was not prepared to make a motion at this time. The preliminary plan still awaits final county agency approvals (Storm Water Management and Development Review outstanding) before returning for formal approval.

application.title: Review and approve Annual Report submittal to the county.

resolutions.summary: The Planning Commission voted unanimously to approve the 2023 Annual Report for submission to Carroll County and the Maryland Department of Planning.
